pipeline: 2. classify (LLM): criterion -> per-span {class, head, threshold_phrase}  <- this artifact
3. structure (code): span -> (op, value, reference_bound, unit) -> Circe
meta.why_llm: Chia classifies by the head -- what the number modifies -- not by the unit. A regex evaluation of the head rule resolved heads for only 62% of value constraints because splitting on 'or' destroys lines like 'ALT, AST, or alkaline phosphatase > 3x ULN'. Head identification is semantic.

prompt_contract.invariant: The prompt is a pure function of this file. Do not hand-edit a prompt alongside it.

spans.head: the noun the number modifies, verbatim, or null when elided
spans.family: one of classes[id=NON_CRITERION].families[].id, only when class is NON_CRITERION

hard_rules: Return a list of spans per criterion, never one span per line. 12 corpus lines carry more than one threshold.
Decide by the head, not by the unit. A time unit does not make a span temporal.
Never default to a class to avoid REVIEW. Every wrong class fails silently as a zero-patient cohort.
Do not normalise, convert or compute. Emit the verbatim phrase; stage 3 owns op, value, bound and unit.
A parenthetical restating a threshold already emitted in another unit is not a second span.

class.purpose: what the number measures, and hence its Circe destination

classes.summary_ko: 환자에게서 측정된 양. 단위가 시간이든 무차원이든 상관없이 head가 검사·활력징후·체격이면 여기.
classes.definition: The number is the result of a measurement or observation made on the patient: a laboratory analyte, a vital sign, an imaging or ECG measurement, or a body metric such as weight or BMI. Decide by the head -- what the number modifies -- never by the unit. A time unit (msec, years) or a dimensionless index (INR) does not move a number out of this class.
classes.circe_destination: Measurement criterion. reference_bound=absolute -> ValueAsNumber with a sibling Unit array; uln -> RangeHighRatio; lln -> RangeLowRatio.

positive: The head is a named analyte, panel term or abbreviation (ALT, AST, bilirubin, creatinine, TSH, HbA1c, INR, ANC, platelets, hemoglobin, AFP, NT-proBNP, HBsAg, calcitonin).
The head is a vital sign or physiologic measurement (systolic/diastolic blood pressure, heart rate, LVEF, QTc, mitral valve area, ST-segment elevation).
The head is a body metric (body weight, BMI).
The phrase names a reference bound (ULN, LLN, upper/lower limit of normal, institutional ULN) -- only measurements have laboratory reference ranges.
The unit is a laboratory or physiologic unit (mg/dL, mmol/L, g/L, /mm3, 10^9/L, mmHg, mL/min, mL/min/1.73m2, ng/mL, pg/mL, IU/mL, mV, msec, %).
negative: The head names a graded clinical scale (ECOG, Child-Pugh, dipstick protein) -> SCORE_GRADE.
The head is a drug and the number is how much of it is given -> DRUG_DOSE.
The head is 'age', or the only head is a bare time unit -> AGE.
The number counts events or says how much was administered, donated or lost -> EVENT_QUANTITY.
The number is the distance in time from an anchor event -> TEMPORAL_WINDOW.

classes.hazard: A uln/lln span must emit only the ratio operand. Circe ANDs siblings, so a RangeHighRatio plus a ValueAsNumber on the same value leaves defect #10 intact. An unrecognised unit must leave Unit unset, never fall back to a near neighbour -- a wrong Unit filter matches zero rows.

unresolved.tension: It is a real exclusion criterion with no number at all, so 'NON_CRITERION' is literally false about it.
unresolved.disposition: Kept, with the class naming_caveat recorded. It is out of scope for a numeric-threshold classifier, not out of scope for the cohort.

unresolved.tension: The second threshold applies only when liver metastases are present. Both spans classify correctly and the condition binding them is unrepresentable.
unresolved.disposition: Both emitted; the conditional is lost. Listed under limits as conditional_thresholds.

unresolved.tension: Each line states a different threshold per sex and the corpus keeps only one half of each.
unresolved.disposition: Classified as plain measurement values; the sex qualifier is outside the span. Listed under limits as sex_conditioned_thresholds.

limits.what: One criterion needing two destinations at once -- 'LVEF < 40% measured within 6 months' is a ValueAsNumber and a StartWindow on the same Measurement.
limits.corpus_evidence: No single corpus entry carries both. The pattern shows only across entries: abs-ml-volume is the quantity half of a blood-donation line and neg-blood-donation-window is the window half of the same construction in another trial.
limits.consequence: A single-label output silently drops one half. The classifier output must be a list of spans per criterion with independent classes, which this taxonomy allows, but nothing in the corpus validates the co-occurring case.

limits.what: ClinicalTrials.gov nests the analyte in a parent bullet and the threshold in child bullets.
limits.corpus_evidence: Zero corpus entries. Every entry's source_text is a single line, so the corpus cannot test this at all.
limits.consequence: The head test has nothing to resolve, the elided-head rule fires, and a lab threshold is classified AGE. This is the taxonomy's largest untested blind spot and it is a corpus construction artefact, not an oversight in the classes.

limits.what: An inclusive range is a real value constraint that stage 3 cannot emit.
limits.corpus_evidence: neg-hba1c-range ('6.5 - 8.5%'). Circe does support it: src/agents/agent3/mappings.py maps 'bt' -> 'bt' and '!bt' appears in docs/sample.json, but value_constraint._CIRCE_OPS admits only gt/gte/lt/lte/eq.
limits.consequence: Classifying ranges as NON_CRITERION permanently drops a real inclusion rule. The correct fix is a stage-3 bt operand, not a taxonomy class.

limits.what: A threshold that applies only under a stated condition.
limits.corpus_evidence: uln-two-on-one-line and uln-25-institutional are the two halves of 'ALT <= 2.5 x ULN unless liver metastases are present in which case <= 5x ULN'.
limits.consequence: The class is right for both spans, but the condition attaching one to the other has nowhere to go. Both thresholds get emitted unconditionally and Circe ANDs them, which is stricter than the protocol.

limits.what: One analyte with different thresholds by sex.
limits.corpus_evidence: abs-gdl-nospace ('<13g/dL for males and <12g/dL for females') and abs-gl-lower ('< 105 g/l in women or < 115 g/l in men'). Only the first half of each is in the corpus.
limits.consequence: The sex qualifier is not part of the span, so both halves become unconditional thresholds on the same concept set.

limits.what: An exception clause modifies a threshold it does not contain.
limits.corpus_evidence: neg-gilbert-carveout is classified NON_CRITERION correctly, but the threshold it modifies (bilirubin <= 1.5 x ULN) is a separate span.
limits.consequence: The exception is dropped and the threshold applies to patients the protocol exempts.

limits.what: unit_conversion_restatement cannot be recognised from the span alone.
limits.corpus_evidence: neg-unit-conversion ('(>13.3 mmol/L)') is identical in form to abs-mmoll ('<0.8 mmol/L'), a real threshold.
limits.consequence: If stage 1 splits the criterion, the restatement becomes a second threshold, and Circe ANDs two mutually exclusive filters -> zero patients.

limits.what: Five classes rest on three or fewer corpus instances: TEMPORAL_WINDOW (3), SCORE_GRADE (3), STATE_DURATION (2), EVENT_QUANTITY (2), DRUG_DOSE (1), REVIEW (1).
limits.corpus_evidence: Counts are computed from the corpus by this generator.
limits.consequence: Their boundaries are asserted from the literature and from Circe's shape, not measured. Any accuracy figure quoted per class below n=5 is noise.

limits.what: Both AGE instances are spelled 'Age <op> N years'.
limits.consequence: '18 years of age or older', 'aged 18-75', 'adult', and the adjectival 'N-year-old' form -- the exact form TIMEX2 and SUTime mis-tag as a duration -- have no corpus instance and are unvalidated.

limits.what: The eq operator has zero corpus instances.
limits.corpus_evidence: Computed: no entry maps to eq.
limits.consequence: Retained in the op table because Circe accepts it, but nothing exercises it. Circe's neq / bt / !bt are likewise absent.

limits.what: All 5 statistical_decision_rule instances come from 3 NEJM papers, none from a protocol.
limits.consequence: The family exists because papers were mixed into the corpus. If stage 1 only ever sees ClinicalTrials.gov eligibility text, this family never fires; if it sees publication text, it fires often and is the highest-risk false positive.
